pois.name: The Santrian Beach Club
pois.description: Sanur's iconic beachfront resort complex — thatched pavilions stepping down to the sand, sunrise-facing pool, and the Pandara beach-club restaurant opening directly onto the promenade.

pois.name: Power Of Now Oasis
pois.description: Beachfront open-air yoga shala directly on Sanur's sunrise beach. Morning Hatha and Vinyasa sessions, drop-in welcome. Unobstructed view over the Lombok Strait.

pois.name: Hyatt Regency Sanur
pois.description: Sanur's largest resort: 363 rooms across 15 ha of tropical gardens, beachfront pool, and the open-air Pizzeria pavilion overlooking the beach path. The NNWW tower block is the district's tallest structure.

pois.name: Sanur Harbour
pois.description: Main departure point for fast-boat services to Nusa Penida, Nusa Lembongan, and Lombok. Boats from 07:00–10:00 daily. Ticket kiosks on the promenade; compare prices as operators vary widely.

pois.name: Villa Ksatria
pois.description: Boutique Balinese compound hotel set two rows back from the beach. Private plunge pools in each villa, stone-carved entrance gates, frangipani-lined pathways. 9 villas, no restaurant on site.

pois.name: Cove Dahayu Sanctuary
pois.description: Restored Dutch colonial villa converted into a boutique spa. Four treatment rooms, traditional Balinese boreh scrub, advance booking required.
